newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets get Monday morning feeling.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets get Monday morning feeling.

text.p: Europe's cotton markets began the week in subdued mood with price-testing enquiry providing most of the action, industry sources said.
Sellers of Central Asian and African upland growths came to a sluggish market but found some low-level demand in Portugal and Germany, they said.
There a few competitive offers of U.S. medium/shorter staple cottons for nearby shipment in circulation but contract details were not available.
The market for long-staple styles in Eastern Europe was neglected with cotton trade in the region generally reported quiet and featureless. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
